summary: The generator patch is correct and in lockstep with aac-tools 7806d46: shared functions are AST-identical and the remaining differences predate the slice. One blocking coverage gap: the main()-level orderings that make HelmCharts publish exposed-host links and pooler interfaces survive mutation, and all 40 tests stay green.

findings.summary: main() order unpinned: calling publish_service_interfaces before reconcile_exposed_services (no exposed-host links) or before the pooler merge (no pooler interfaces) keeps all 40 tests green
